0597d052.text:
upon the lakeshore, Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran were the foremost, having the touch of Azshara, the Kaldorei's beloved queen, in their creation. Her favored servitors, those of the Highborne, she brought to the twin towns to reside, and to govern them she placed Athrikus Narassin, though it would be that he would spend most of his days in his Tower of Althalaxx, some ways removed of the towns.

His second, a mage known of his prowess in the arcane arts as much as with his physical abilities,
0597d052.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

4788a2ed.text:
was Asterion, who lived among the people of Bashal'Aran, and went many times to Ameth'Aran, to see to the needs and wants of its people.

And so it was, upon the shores of the Well of Eternity, the twin towns grew and prospered, while the world beneath the stars fell slowly to madness.
4788a2ed.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

5f2f8c31.text:
Long had the children of the stars dwelled upon the banks of the shimmering waters of the Eternal Well. To all was known that Elune, light of the eternal twilight, aspect and goddess of the moon, dwelt within its waters at such time that she rested from her works. Upon the shores of the Well did the children of the stars, favored of Elune, build their homes, even as their gaze was trained ever skyward, into the moonlit night.

Though there were many towns and places of habitation constructed
5f2f8c31.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

9dd6367a.text:
The earth trembled as the ancient trees in the enchanted forest were uprooted and toppled. The groves and glades tended by the sons and daughters of Cenarius and the stone towers of the children of the stars were brought to the rolling ground. There was our queen, radiant even in the desperation, in the chaos that was the battles. The enchanted sky changed colors with the discharge of magic, with the explosions that threatened to tear the world asunder.

Brother fought brother. Chosen fought
9dd6367a.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11869|49ff395c.name: Ansekhwa
11869|49ff395c.text: I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.

14728|b050140a.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
14728|b050140a.text:
Hail brother... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.

We $r have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of $r everywhere in helping us out!

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

3050|18f1109b.name: Veren Tallstrider
3050|18f1109b.text: The $r are sons and daughters of the Earthmother, and we show respect to all her children.  Even the beasts we slay are cherished, as their bodies give nourishment and their skins provide warmth.

3057|690a7170.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|690a7170.text:
Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.

The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

3066|1605f087.name: Narm Skychaser
3066|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3069|03b30234.name: Chaw Stronghide
3069|03b30234.text: We live and die, and the land remains, eternal, unmoved by our passage. Thus, land cannot belong to us, $N. Instead, we belong to it. Therefore we protect the land, for without it we cannot hope to survive.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3616|29aa26bd.name: Onu
3616|29aa26bd.text:
The wind whispers to those who listen...

Do you hear it?

3703|27687fdd.name: Krulmoo Fullmoon
3703|27687fdd.text: I do not offer apprentice training. Look for the $r Waldor in the Wailing Caverns, here in the Barrens. He can assist you with whatever you need.

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

5939|a28d29e1.name: Vira Younghoof
5939|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6746|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Pala
6746|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

1003-progress.name: Unknown
1003-progress.text:
You hear singing coming from Buzzbox 525.

"Though crawler wine's shweet, and thresher ale fine, and moonstalker moonshine ish grand. There's nothing sho dear, as a thistle bear beer, and shoon I shall have shome on hand!"

The hatch is open and awaits the 4 grizzled scalps as you hear the song repeated over and over.
1003-progress.title: Buzzbox 525

1524-progress.name: Telf Joolam
1524-progress.text: Greetin's, $N. You've found yourself at the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. Only those knowledgeable enough in the shamanistic arts will ever learn the secrets of this place and the power it holds. I'm sorry you made the trip all this way, only to be turned back now--the journey up here is far from safe after all--but I am the keeper of the shrine, and I cannot allow just anyone to wander around here.
1524-progress.title: Call of Fire

1525-progress.name: Telf Joolam
1525-progress.text:
I have enough ingredients for a sapta of fire if you can find the reagent pouch and some fire tar. The Burning Blade fanatics carry the proper components for most of their spells in those pouches, and usually have enough of the items I need that we will not have to search much farther for anything else.

The saptas are always made from ingredients that are closely tied to their respective elements. It makes our work easier because of the warlocks' ties to fire.
1525-progress.title: Call of Fire

1526-progress.name: Unknown
1526-progress.text: The brazier stands about a third your height, and looks normal, save for the inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch.
1526-progress.title: Call of Fire

1527-progress.name: Kranal Fiss
1527-progress.text: Yes, $N? What do you have there?
1527-progress.title: Call of Fire

952-progress.name: Onu
952-progress.text: Ah.$c. How may Onu assist you?
952-progress.title: Grove of the Ancients

97485-complete.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-complete.text:
You have done well, friend.

I thank you for taking the time to perform one of our time-honored traditions, $N. I hope that as you travel you will find plenty of occasions you wish to give thanks for.

Should you ever wish to perform the ritual again, you should be able to repurchase the components I sent you to collect.

Go with An'she's warmth.
97485-complete.title: Traditions of the Bluff

98424-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
98424-progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?
98424-progress.title: Fizsprocket's Notes
